newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices fall on sluggish demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices fall on sluggish demand.

text.p: Indian copper prices on Tuesday extended losses while other base metals were unchanged in narrow trade, dealers said.

Ready copper fell by 50 rupees to 12,600 rupees per quintal on sluggish demand and fresh offerings, after a similar fall on Monday. "Fear that state-owned Hindustan Copper may slash selling prices also dragged copper downward," one dealer said.

Nickel was steady at the improved level of 38,500 rupees, after gaining on 100 rupees on Monday. Tin was unchanged at 35,600 rupees, zinc at 6,300 rupees and lead at 4,850 rupees, on limited activity. Aluminium was quiet at 7,450 rupees.
